summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a cash dividend of $0.05350 per share, totaling approximately $69 million. The dividend has a record date of June 2, 2026, and a payment date of June 17, 2026. Israeli tax withholding applies at standard rates, with potential refunds for foreign residents trading on NYSE. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a special situation event. The filing serves as an ordinary dividend declaration, mapping to a US dividend press release. What to watch: any subsequent share-price adjustment post-ex-dividend date.
